version.approval_notes: Version 2.0.1 adds an opt-in multi-year renewal quotation workflow for authorized Odoo Customer Success users. It invokes narrowly validated native Odoo renewal, plan-copy, global-discount, and Share operations through the current same-origin Odoo session. Share URLs remain only in volatile tab memory and are never logged, persisted, or transmitted to the developer. Account Health and Industry controls now also support Paused subscriptions after revalidating the technical server state before each write. The update adds no browser permission, analytics, advertising, external service, background worker, or data collection. Firefox is signed from the exact attached, checksummed build artifact; the attached human-readable source archive contains tracked regular files only and can be reproduced with Node 22 and pnpm 10.
